notes: Group B part 1: re-check of 13 stored US food-truck / market / pop-up tools; no new vendors searched (one search only, to find Truckster's own site). Food Truck ONE settled as eligible: customers order online from their phone and pick up (homepage says 'pay at pickup', /software says 'pay ahead'); it also has a free directory and a phone register. Its Fleet plan now shows 'Custom', not the stored 99. Where's The Foodtruck has changed from a free listing to order-ahead with a kitchen display, still free and 0% commission. Food Truck Pub's Premium is $29.00/month when paid annually; its features page also says 'No transaction fees or monthly fees to truck owners.', which conflicts with the plans page (customers pay a $1.25 / $0.60 convenience fee). Hotplate's food evidence is pop-ups, not food trucks by name. Restolabs' plan prices appear as '$00/' placeholders (likely filled by script), so they're recorded as hidden. Ordering.co is not_relevant: a restaurant tool with no food-truck wording, and the US has many food-truck tools. Unreadable: Best Food Trucks (429 on customers. and www.), StreetFoodFinder (403), Homegrown (too many redirects), Truckster (own site gotruckster.com found via the App Store privacy URL but answered 405; update the stored website). Card readers or tills at the hatch are not recorded.
